item.title: Former Gang Member Says Protesting ICE Is A Death Wish
item.description: I diligently note Black voices outside of the conservative coalition opposed to mass migration. In this vein I offer a candid clip featuring a former gang member with good sense: "I know the law plus I know common sense", is one of his closing statements which resonated with me.

item.title: CCF Demands Winnipeg Scrap Bylaw That Would Silence Protesters
item.description: WINNIPEG – The Canadian Constitution Foundation (CCF) has sent a letter to the City of Winnipeg urging officials to immediately abandon the proposed bylaw that would prohibit most protests within 100 metres of schools, hospitals, and places of worship.

item.title: The Road to Communism ﻿Part 2: ﻿Weaponized Media
item.description: We live in a time of massive media weaponization. It is all too easy to manipulate information. With the internet, social media, TV, cable and streaming services, Hollywood, and academia, even the most degenerate voices have access to a microphone or computer keyboard.

item.title: Supreme Court Sides With CCF: Charter Protects Broad Right to Mobility
item.description: OTTAWA – The Supreme Court of Canada released its decision today in Taylor v. Canada, recognizing that Canadians have a broad constitutional right to travel freely between provinces.Siding with the Canadian Constitution Foundation (the CCF), the Court found that section 6 of the Charter provides a broad right to mobility simpliciter.
